claims.author: Ian Rapoport
claims.text: Samuel (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

claims.author: Brooke Evans
claims.text: Stout (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Brooke Evans of the 49ers' official site reports.

claims.author: Harrison Rich
claims.text: Black (illness) upgraded to a full practice Thursday, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

claims.author: Corbin Smith
claims.text: Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the reserve/PUP list ahead of Thursday's game versus the Broncos, Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said after Sunday's 32-29 loss to the 49ers, Corbin Smith of Emerald City Spectrum reports.

claims.author: Curtis Crabtree
claims.text: Thomas (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against the 49ers, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

claims.author: John Boyle
claims.text: The Seahawks placed Neal (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: John Boyle
claims.text: Charles (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

claims.author: Bob Condotta
claims.text: Williams (ankle) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.

claims.author: John Boyle
claims.text: Okada (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

claims.author: Scott Smith
claims.text: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Friday that he plans on starting Daniels in Week 6 against Pittsburgh, Scott Smith of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: Rick Stroud
claims.text: Head coach Todd Bowles said Friday that Mayfield (thumb) now is in a smaller splint, and the Bucs will see if he can progress to gripping the football next week, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

claims.author: Brianna Dix
claims.text: Kieft (elbow) does not carry an injury designation into Thursday's game against the Cowboys, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

claims.author: Jenna Laine
claims.text: Head coach Todd Bowles said Melifonwu is likely to start at safety Thursday night against Dallas, Jenna Laine of ESPN.com reports.

claims.author: Brianna Dix
claims.text: Bain (groin) was listed as a full participant on the Buccaneers' estimated injury report Monday, Brianna Dix of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: Terry McCormick
claims.text: Winston (quadriceps) will undergo an MRI, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

claims.author: Jim Wyatt
claims.text: The Titans elevated Mullings from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: Jim Wyatt
claims.text: Williams (pectoral) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Texans, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

claims.author: Jim Wyatt
claims.text: Helm (knee) does not carry an injury designation for Sunday's AFC South showdown against the Texans, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
